name: Finnmark Combination Outdoor Barrel Sauna—FD-6, Cedar
description: Finnmark Hybrid (Infrared & Traditional Outdoor Barrel Sauna) 6x6, Cedar Looking to experience the best of both worlds in sauna therapy? The Finnmark Cedar Combination Barrel Sauna seamlessly combines the benefits Finnmark’s UL-listed Spectrum Plus™ infrared sauna panels with a traditional Finnish rock sauna, creating a wellness sanctuary unlike any other. Crafted from thick Canadian Cedar, this sauna radiates natural beauty, durability, and a rich, aromatic atmosphere. Premium design elements, such as tempered glass panels, dual-level cedar benches, and a full shingle kit, ensure both elegance and longevity. Paired with cutting-edge features like Finnmark Spectrum Plus™ infrared heaters, a traditional 4.5kW heater, Wi-Fi-enabled controls, and customizable RGB lighting, this sauna delivers luxury, performance, and relaxation in perfect harmony. Features: Spectrum Plus™ UL Listed short wave infrared heaters for deep penetrating heat, up to 25x more than standard carbon panel heaters.
